text:
elaine (pm): Dropped a short plan for Q3 regional-routing pilots. Need to agree on pilot scope + launch gates. link: https://redwood.share/q3-routing-plan

samir (arch): Proposal: keep isolation route-scoped. Modes: soft-affinity (preferred region + fallback), strict-affinity (pinned, no fallback), hybrid (pinned for payments, soft for others).

miguel (eng): Tech caveat: strict-affinity ⇢ node labels / reserved pools. Will reduce bin-packing. I'll produce a short sizing delta for 3 candidates once product selects pilots.

nina (sre): Ops checklist (canary): 5% traffic, 20m stability, p95 <= 2x baseline, rollback if error-rate >0.5% or fallback_count >2/min. Add synthetic check per-region.

tara (cs): Customer ask: per-route residency + audit log entries for each routing decision. We need a plain-language policy summary for contracts and a comms template.

samir (arch): Minimal policy DSL sample for product/legal to review:
```
policy payments_finco {
  match: {customer: "FinCo", route: "payments"}
  isolation: "strict"
  regions: ["eu-west-1"]
  fallback: {allowed: false}
}
```

miguel (eng): Also include autoscale defaults: min_reserved=1, max_burst=2x, eviction_window=5m. If product doesn't pick defaults we'll use conservative values.

elaine (pm): Actions: 1) Product add pilot rows by Mon EOD. 2) Eng sizing (miguel) Tue. 3) SRE runbook + probes (nina) Tue. 4) CS/legal policy summary (tara) Tue. We'll pick two pilots Wed and send customer onramp note. ops-bot: please queue telemetry proxy deploy to staging.

ops-bot: deploy queued: infra/policy-telemetry v0.5 -> staging (triggered by samir).
